items_flat.title_en: Anthropic releases Claude Opus 5 — near-frontier intelligence at half the price of Fable 5
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 發布 Claude Opus 5——近 Fable 5 前沿智能、價格僅一半
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic announced Claude Opus 5 on July 24, 2026. It is available today as the new default on Claude Max and the strongest model on Claude Pro. The model delivers performance close to Claude Fable 5 at roughly half the price, with $5/$25 per million tokens matching Opus 4.8, plus gains in agentic coding, computer use and long-horizon knowledge work.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 於 2026 年 7 月 24 日宣布推出 Claude Opus 5。今日起成為 Claude Max 預設模型、Claude Pro 上最強選項。性能接近 Claude Fable 5，價格約一半（每百萬 token $5/$25，與 Opus 4.8 相同），並在代理編碼、電腦使用與長程知識工作上有明顯提升。
items_flat.analysis_en: The release strengthens Anthropic’s position in the high-value but cost-sensitive mid-to-high tier, potentially shifting economics for heavy agentic and enterprise workloads. Real-world consistency and gains versus Fable 5 remain to be fully stress-tested at scale.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此發布強化 Anthropic 在高價值但成本敏感的中高階市場定位，可能改變代理與企業工作負載的經濟結構。相對於 Fable 5 的實戰一致性與增益仍待大規模驗證。
items_flat.quote: It's a thoughtful and proactive model that comes close to the frontier intelligence of Claude Fable 5 at half the price.
items_flat.quote_zh: 它是一個深思熟慮且積極主動的模型，性能接近 Claude Fable 5 的前沿智能，價格僅一半。

items_flat.title_en: NVIDIA, Microsoft, Meta, OpenAI and 20+ organizations release open letter defending open-weight AI models
items_flat.title_zh: NVIDIA、Microsoft、Meta、OpenAI 等 20+ 組織發表公開信捍衛 open-weight AI 模型
items_flat.summary_en: On July 24, 2026 a coalition of more than 25 organizations including NVIDIA, Microsoft, Meta, Mistral, Hugging Face, IBM, OpenAI, Y Combinator, Andreessen Horowitz, Dell, Palantir and others published the letter “Open Weights and American AI Leadership”. It urges policymakers to avoid premature restrictions on open-weight models to support U.S. innovation, competition, safety and sovereignty.
items_flat.summary_zh: 2026 年 7 月 24 日，NVIDIA、Microsoft、Meta、Mistral、Hugging Face、IBM、OpenAI、Y Combinator、a16z、Dell、Palantir 等超過 25 個組織發表《Open Weights and American AI Leadership》公開信，呼籲政策制定者避免對 open-weight 模型施加過早限制，以維護美國創新、競爭、安全與主權。
items_flat.analysis_en: The letter marks a rare public alignment of major closed-model ecosystem players, open-source advocates and the leading GPU maker against broad restrictions on open weights. It reflects industry pushback amid U.S. debates over Chinese open models, though Anthropic and Google remain absent.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此信罕見地讓封閉模型生態主要玩家、開源倡導者與頂尖 GPU 廠商公開站隊，反對對 open weights 的廣泛限制。反映美國針對中國開源模型辯論中的產業反推，但 Anthropic 與 Google 仍未簽署。
items_flat.quote: The world needs both frontier closed models and frontier open models.
items_flat.quote_zh: 世界需要前沿封閉模型，也需要前沿開源模型。

items_flat.title_en: NVIDIA expands Korea AI factory partnerships with SK Group ($500B+) and NAVER/Brookfield
items_flat.title_zh: NVIDIA 擴大與 SK Group（500 億美元+）及 NAVER/Brookfield 的韓國 AI 工廠合作
items_flat.summary_en: On July 24, 2026 NVIDIA announced expanded partnerships in Korea: a $500-billion-plus initiative with SK Group including SK Telecom’s up-to-2GW Vera Rubin DSX AI Factory (targeted 2027) and long-term next-generation memory (including HBM) co-development with SK hynix; plus NAVER, NVIDIA and Brookfield expanding national AI factory infrastructure toward gigawatt scale, with NVIDIA investing $1 billion in NAVER.
items_flat.summary_zh: 2026 年 7 月 24 日，NVIDIA 宣布擴大韓國合作：與 SK Group 啟動 500 億美元以上計畫，包括 SK Telecom 最高 2GW Vera Rubin DSX AI 工廠（目標 2027 上線）及與 SK hynix 共研下一代記憶體（含 HBM）；另與 NAVER、Brookfield 擴展國家級 AI 工廠基礎設施至 GW 規模，NVIDIA 投資 NAVER 10 億美元。
items_flat.analysis_en: These deals underscore NVIDIA’s central role in global sovereign AI infrastructure buildout and Korea’s ambition to move from AI adopter to producer, securing long-term GPU and memory supply chains amid surging demand.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這些交易凸顯 NVIDIA 在全球主權 AI 基礎設施建設的核心角色，以及韓國從 AI 採用者轉向生產者的野心，在需求暴增下鎖定長期 GPU 與記憶體供應鏈。
items_flat.quote: South Korea has all the ingredients to become a global AI powerhouse — world-class networks and data centers, leadership in chip technology and vast industrial scale. Together with SK Telecom and SK hynix, we are building a new generation of AI factories that will power Korea’s next wave of growth.
items_flat.quote_zh: 韓國具備成為全球 AI 強國的所有條件——世界級網路與資料中心、晶片技術領導地位與龐大工業規模。與 SK Telecom 和 SK hynix 一起，我們正在打造新一代 AI 工廠，驅動韓國下一波成長。

items_flat.title_en: xAI launches free Grok add-on for Google Workspace
items_flat.title_zh: xAI 推出免費 Grok Google Workspace 附加元件
items_flat.summary_en: On July 24, 2026 xAI released a free add-on that places Grok in a side panel inside Google Docs, Sheets and Slides. Users can analyze data and write formulas in Sheets, turn outlines into presentations with research and images in slides, and draft or edit documents in Docs, with optional connectors to Drive and email.
items_flat.summary_zh: 2026 年 7 月 24 日，xAI 推出免費附加元件，讓 Grok 以側邊欄形式進入 Google Docs、Sheets 與 Slides。Sheets 可分析數據寫公式、Slides 可從大綱研究並加圖生成簡報、Docs 可起草編輯文件，並支援 Drive/郵件連接。
items_flat.analysis_en: The move embeds Grok directly into daily productivity workflows, competing for the same surface occupied by Gemini and Copilot. It is a practical distribution play rather than a capability leap, expanding access without requiring users to leave their existing tools.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉直接把 Grok 嵌入日常生產力流程，與 Gemini、Copilot 爭奪同一介面。屬實用分發策略而非能力躍進，讓用戶無需離開既有工具即可使用。
items_flat.quote: Today we're bringing Grok into Google Workspace. One add-on puts Grok beside the file you have open in Sheets, Slides, and Docs.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們把 Grok 帶進 Google Workspace。一個附加元件讓 Grok 出現在你開啟的 Sheets、Slides 和 Docs 檔案旁邊。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic Frontier Red Team publishes Project Pilot on AI models controlling real drones
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 前沿紅隊發布 Project Pilot：AI 模型控制真實無人機研究
items_flat.summary_en: On July 24, 2026 Anthropic’s Frontier Red Team (with Andon Labs) released research evaluating whether frontier models can autonomously control a quadcopter drone for locate-and-follow tasks. They introduced Drone-Bench covering reconstruction, localization, navigation, detection and following; current models show progress especially in detection and following but reconstruction remains a bottleneck, with Claude Fable 5 strongest overall yet still failing some end-to-end real-world navigation.
items_flat.summary_zh: 2026 年 7 月 24 日，Anthropic 前沿紅隊（與 Andon Labs 合作）發布研究，評估前沿模型能否自主控制四旋翼無人機執行定位與跟隨任務。他們推出 Drone-Bench 涵蓋重建、定位、導航、偵測與跟隨；目前模型在偵測與跟隨有進展，但重建仍是瓶頸，Claude Fable 5 整體最強但真實導航仍會失敗。
items_flat.analysis_en: The work documents concrete progress of language models into physical-world agency and surfaces dual-use governance questions around surveillance-capable autonomy before systems become reliable enough for widespread deployment.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此研究記錄語言模型邁向物理世界代理的具體進展，並在系統可靠到可廣泛部署前，凸顯具監控能力的自主性所帶來的雙重用途治理問題。
items_flat.quote: A key reason why Anthropic has a Frontier Red Team is to measure capabilities like this, giving us situational awareness into how close we are to the world in which AI can autonomously pilot robots—with all the attendant benefits and risks.
items_flat.quote_zh: Anthropic 設立前沿紅隊的一個關鍵原因，是衡量這類能力，讓我們對 AI 能自主駕駛機器人的世界有多近有清晰的情境認知——伴隨所有利益與風險。

items_flat.title_en: Meta AI advances agentic capabilities with Muse Spark 1.1
items_flat.title_zh: Meta AI 以 Muse Spark 1.1 推進代理能力
items_flat.summary_en: On July 24, 2026 Meta announced that Meta AI, powered by Muse Spark 1.1, can now make plans, connect to email and calendar apps, create slides, and handle multi-step tasks on users’ behalf. Features include daily briefings, research and real-time steering, with the update rolling out in select markets in the Meta AI app and on meta.ai.
items_flat.summary_zh: 2026 年 7 月 24 日，Meta 宣布 Meta AI（由 Muse Spark 1.1 驅動）現可制定計劃、連接郵件與日曆應用、創建簡報，並代表用戶處理多步驟任務。功能包括每日簡報、研究與即時引導，更新正在部分市場的 Meta AI 應用與 meta.ai 上線。
items_flat.analysis_en: The update moves Meta AI further into practical agentic territory, competing more directly with personal-assistant experiences from other labs. Real-world reliability of multi-step planning and external app actions remains the key uncertainty.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此更新讓 Meta AI 更進一步進入實用代理領域，更直接與其他實驗室的個人助理體驗競爭。多步驟規劃與外部應用操作的實戰可靠性仍是關鍵不確定性。
items_flat.quote: Powered by Muse Spark 1.1, Meta AI can now make plans, connect to email and calendar apps, create slides, and handle tasks on your behalf.
items_flat.quote_zh: 由 Muse Spark 1.1 驅動，Meta AI 現可制定計劃、連接郵件與日曆應用、創建簡報，並代表你處理任務。
